title: Meta AI Can Remember You? Muse Wonder Explained (Who Gets Access)
description:
Meta just announced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full. Could AI remember your trip preferences across conversations, or keep working after its first approach fails? We explain Meta's Active Memory and Active Focus claims with realistic **illustrative** examples, then clarify who can actually access the new models.

This video is an independent commentary/explainer, not a sponsored Meta demo. The travel-planning notes and app-building sequences are original fictional illustrations, NOT footage of a tested Muse Wonder account. Meta claims are not verified guarantees of independent real-world performance. Never disclose passwords or financial secrets to an AI service just because it appears helpful.

ACCESS (as announced October 12, 2026): Muse Wonder is available through the Meta Model API and Muse Code, while Muse Wonder Full is available to Muse Code subscribers. Muse app rollout begins later and first reaches subscribers; availability varies.
